name: mailbox-triage
description: Triages an Exchange and/or Gmail inbox: classifies recent mail into priority groups, files it, and saves a draft report.

interface.shortDescription: Triage an inbox: classify, file, and summarize.
interface.longDescription: Fetches recent inbox mail from Exchange, Gmail, or both, classifies it into priority groups, files each message into the right Exchange folder or Gmail label, and saves a triage summary as a draft. Runs unattended; never sends, forwards, or deletes mail.
